listType.title: List type
listType.description: "Tenders" = routine procurement notices posted government-wide by individual ministries (671+ since May 2022, mostly Dutch, one line per notice: title, ministry, date, link). "Notices" = larger internationally/donor-financed solicitations (World Bank, IDB, Social Bond program) with full bid details -- background, procurement method, eligibility, deadline, submission address -- mostly English, currently-open only (~11 at a time).
enumTitles: Notices (donor-financed, full bid details, currently open)

categorySlug.title: Ministry/category filter (tenders only)
categorySlug.description: Optional. Restrict "tenders" results to one ministry/sector's WordPress category slug, e.g. "openbare-werken-ruimtelijke-ordening" (Public Works & Spatial Planning), "landbouw-veeteelt-en-visserij" (Agriculture, Livestock & Fisheries), "olie-gas-en-milieu" (Oil, Gas & Environment). Leave blank for every ministry. Ignored for listType=notices.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many records are kept in the output for this run.
